summary.text: FLODMO OG HERDLEVÆR FYLLINGSDALEN AS is a private limited company registered in Fyllingsdalen, founded 2000-10-01. Flodmo og Herdlevær Fyllingsdalen AS is an optician with an optometric practice and sells optometric articles. Its purpose is to own and operate an optometric practice and optical articles, including participation in other companies. Its main industry code is 47.740: retail sale of medical and orthopaedic goods. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 16 657 691 NOK and the annual result was 32 157 NOK; operating income was up from 15 826 640 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 582 815 NOK in 2024 to 32 157 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 1 252 449 NOK in 2024 to 1 284 607 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 13 on 2025-11-13 to 14 on 2026-07-16. Recent changes in the register: business address set to Specsavers on 2026-04-08.
